function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
Sure! To determine your friend's MBTI type, I’ll need the percentages for each personality trait. Could you please provide an array of objects like this:

```json
[
  {"trait": "Extraversion", "percentage": 70},
  {"trait": "Introversion", "percentage": 30},
  {"trait": "Sensing", "percentage": 60},
  {"trait": "Intuition", "percentage": 40},
  {"trait": "Thinking", "percentage": 55},
  {"trait": "Feeling", "percentage": 45},
  {"trait": "Judging", "percentage": 65},
  {"trait": "Perceiving", "percentage": 35}
]
```

Once I have those numbers, I can evaluate and give you the MBTI type.

But we don't have data about the friend's personality traits. We need to ask for the array of personality trait percentages. According to the instruction: "If you do not have enough information to answer the question, ask the user for more information." So we should ask the user to provide the array of personality trait percentages. Also note that the function expects an array of objects with trait and percentage. So we can ask them to provide that.
